claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mestranol is a prodrug estrogen with weak ER binding that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any modest antiproliferative effect would reflect weak estrogen receptor-mediated growth modulation rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
